Relief shown pictorially. "Tome XII, in 4⁰, no. 1." "Tome 10, in 8⁰, page 1." Shows southern United States, eastern Mexico, Central America, northern South America, and West Indies. Appears in Jean Francois de la Harpe's Abrégé de l'histoire générale des voyages. 1780. Scale ca. 1:7,500,000.
